planets.name: TOI-1238 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1238 with a 3.29-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1238 c was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1238. Its orbit and size follow González-Álvarez et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
